text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: The nurse liked the cream buns from that shop, didn't she? All right—

text_block_list.name: Bakery Owner
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, sorry about that... We actually stopped
selling the cream buns last month~."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (It's a shame, but it can't be helped...)

Unable to buy souvenirs for their benefactors,
KS Miracle hung their head in dejection...
